description: This file defines an interface EmployeeDao for data access operations related to Employee entities, including methods to retrieve, save, and delete employees.

classes.name: EmployeeDao
classes.description: Java interface for Employee Data Access Object, providing method signatures for CRUD operations on Employee entities.

methods.name: retrieveEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee object corresponding to the given employee ID.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists the provided Employee object to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployee
methods.description: Deletes the Employee record associated with the given employee ID.
